title: [RPG Design Guides] Support Skills ② Problems and Solutions

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】補助技② 問題点と対策
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Support Skills ② Problems and Solutions

blocks.source: 補助技の問題点まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary of Support Skill Problems

blocks.source: 以下のような問題点が挙げられる。
blocks.translation: The following problems can be identified.

blocks.source: 有用性が分かり辛い。ザコ戦で無用
blocks.translation: Their Usefulness Is Difficult to Understand; Useless in Regular Battles

blocks.source: 攻撃技・回復技と比較すると、直接的な効果がないため有用性が分かり辛い。特に効果が小さい場合や、重ねがけが前提で一度の効果が小さい場合は顕著。また、ザコ戦だと、補助を使うよりも、攻撃で敵をさっさと倒した方が効率良い場合が多い。最悪、プレイヤーに使って貰えず存在価値がない場合も。
blocks.translation: Compared with offensive and healing skills, their usefulness is difficult to understand because they have no direct effect. This is especially true when the effect is small, or when the skill is designed to be stacked and each individual use has only a minor effect. In regular battles, it is also often more efficient to defeat enemies quickly with attacks than to use support skills. In the worst case, players may never use them, leaving them with no value at all.

blocks.source: 難易度の変動
blocks.translation: Fluctuating Difficulty

blocks.source: 効果が強すぎると、補助技を習得したタイミングで一気に難易度が変動する。
blocks.translation: If the effect is too powerful, the difficulty can change drastically as soon as the player learns the support skill.

blocks.source: メリハリが付くという利点もあるが、補助技の有用性というのは、上級者ほど気付きやすい。それに気付かない初心者との間に難易度格差が発生する。
blocks.translation: Although this can provide a sense of contrast, advanced players are more likely to recognize the usefulness of support skills. This creates a difficulty gap between them and beginners who fail to notice it.

blocks.source: 例えば、筆者は前回記述したＦＦ４においてブリンクの有用性に気付かずベヒーモスと戦った結果、「物理でも魔法でも反撃してきてイライラする。何て理不尽なゲームだ」と長年思っていた。
blocks.translation: For example, in FFIV, which I mentioned previously, I fought Behemoth without realizing the usefulness of Blink. As a result, I spent many years thinking, “It counters both physical and magical attacks. How frustrating. What an unfair game.”

blocks.source: 定例作業
blocks.translation: Routine Tasks

blocks.source: 使えば明らかに有利という程に強力な場合、補助技の使用が単なる定例作業と化す。
blocks.translation: When a support skill is so powerful that using it clearly provides an advantage, using support skills becomes nothing more than a routine task.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＤＱにおけるバイキルトやＦＦ（特にＣＴＢの１０）におけるヘイストがそれ。ボス戦において、相手が打ち消す技を持たない場合は、何も考えずに戦闘開始と同時にかけておけばいい。重ねがけが可能な場合は、さらに作業量が増大する。
blocks.translation: Examples include Bikill in DQ and Haste in FF (especially CTB 10). In a boss battle, if the opponent has no skill that can remove the effect, you can simply cast it at the start of battle without giving it any thought. If effects can be stacked, the amount of busywork increases even further.

blocks.source: 戦闘終盤が盛り上がらない
blocks.translation: The End of Battle Lacks Excitement

blocks.source: 効果が強すぎると、ボス戦であっても「パーティの強化が終われば後は楽勝」となりやすい。戦闘の序盤は緊張感があっても、終盤になると気が抜けるという展開になりかねない。
blocks.translation: If the effects are too powerful, even boss battles can easily become a matter of “Once the party is fully buffed, the rest is a breeze.” This can result in a battle that feels tense at the beginning but loses its tension toward the end.

blocks.source: 当然、ピンチからの大逆転というようなドラマは生まれにくい。
blocks.translation: Naturally, it becomes difficult to create drama such as a dramatic reversal from a desperate situation.

blocks.source: イタチごっこ
blocks.translation: An Endless Back-and-Forth

blocks.source: かといって、凍てつく波動のように、打消し技を用意すると、補助技とのしつこいイタチごっこになる。テンポが悪化したり、効果の薄い補助技が使われなくなる。同様に、時間経過で補助が切れるようにした場合も、類似の問題点がある。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, if you prepare a skill that removes buffs, such as Disruptive Wave, it can lead to a persistent back-and-forth with support skills. The battle’s pace may suffer, and support skills with weaker effects may stop being used. Similar problems arise if support effects are designed to expire over time.

blocks.source: 間接的な価値の低下
blocks.translation: A Decline in Indirect Value

blocks.source: 特定種類の攻撃を強化する補助技は、それ以外の攻撃技の価値を間接的に引き下げる。例えば、ＤＱの場合、物理攻撃を強化するバイキルトの存在によって、強化手段の無い魔法攻撃の価値が低くなってしまう傾向がある。
blocks.translation: Support skills that enhance a specific type of attack indirectly reduce the value of other attack skills. For example, in DQ, the presence of Bikill, which strengthens physical attacks, tends to lower the value of magical attacks, which have no corresponding means of enhancement.

blocks.source: 意図しない補助役化
blocks.translation: Unintended Shift to a Support Role

blocks.source: 補助技の使用にターンを取られて、そのキャラクターの攻撃技を使う機会が減る。補助専門キャラなら良いが、そうでない場合はキャラの魅力を削ぐ事になる。例えば、ＤＱシリーズの魔法使いは、時にバイキルトに追われて魔法攻撃をするヒマが無いことがある。
blocks.translation: Using support skills takes up turns, reducing opportunities for that character to use offensive skills. This is fine for a character specializing in support, but otherwise it diminishes the character’s appeal. For example, in the DQ series, a mage can sometimes be so busy casting Bikill that they have no time to use offensive magic.

blocks.source: 問題点に対する対策
blocks.translation: Solutions to These Problems

blocks.source: 様々な問題点に対して、対応策を考えてみた。
blocks.translation: I considered solutions to these various problems.

blocks.source: 補助技の種類を厳選する
blocks.translation: Carefully Select the Types of Support Skills

blocks.source: 有効な補助技が多数存在する場合、「戦闘開始時に長々と補助技でパーティを強化する」ような定例作業に陥りやすい。そのため、作成する補助技の種類を厳選することが有効。
blocks.translation: When there are many effective support skills, the game is likely to fall into a routine task of “spending a long time strengthening the party with support skills at the start of battle.” Therefore, it is effective to carefully select the types of support skills you create.

blocks.source: 特に攻撃力アップ、ＣＴＢにおける素早さアップなど、常に便利すぎる補助技は意義をよく考えよう。
blocks.translation: In particular, carefully consider the purpose of support skills that are always too convenient, such as Attack Power buffs and Speed buffs in CTB.

blocks.source: 別種の補助技における重複禁止
blocks.translation: Prevent Overlap Between Different Types of Support Skills

blocks.source: 物理半減と魔法半減など、別種の補助技の効果を重複できないようにして、同時に使用できる補助技を限定する。狙いは補助技の厳選と同じ。
blocks.translation: Prevent the effects of different support skills, such as halving physical damage and halving magical damage, from overlapping, thereby limiting which support skills can be used simultaneously. The goal is the same as carefully selecting support skills.

blocks.source: 重ねがけは禁止する
blocks.translation: Do Not Allow Stacking

blocks.source: 重ねがけが有効なタイプの補助技は「ザコ戦では一度の効果が低く使いづらい」「ボス戦では強化が終われば楽勝」というように両極端になりやすい。また、ボス戦のバランスを重ねがけ前提で調整すると、長引いてテンポ悪化の原因にもなる。
blocks.translation: Support skills designed to be effective when stacked tend to become extreme in both directions: “Their single-use effect is too weak and they are difficult to use in regular battles,” while “boss battles are easy once the party is fully buffed.” In addition, if boss battle balance is adjusted on the assumption that effects will be stacked, battles may drag on and cause the pace to suffer.

blocks.source: 基本的には重ねがけは禁止して、一度の効果を高くした方が万人受けかと思う。
blocks.translation: As a general rule, I think it is more broadly appealing to prohibit stacking and make each use more effective.

blocks.source: デメリットを付ける
blocks.translation: Add Drawbacks

blocks.source: 補助技にデメリットを付けることにより、使用するタイミングを考えさせる。
blocks.translation: Adding drawbacks to support skills makes players think about when to use them.

blocks.source: 例えば「攻撃魔法を反射するが、回復魔法まで反射してしまう」「攻撃魔法を半減するが、回復魔法まで半減してしまう」「物理攻撃を回避するが、魔法攻撃に弱くなってしまう」「攻撃力が上昇するが、守備力が下がる」など。
blocks.translation: For example: “Reflects offensive magic, but also reflects healing magic,” “Halves offensive magic damage, but also halves healing magic,” “Evades physical attacks, but makes the user more vulnerable to magical attacks,” or “Raises Attack Power but lowers Defense.”

blocks.source: ただし、上級プレイヤー向けの感は否めないかも。
blocks.translation: However, it may be hard to deny that this approach is geared toward advanced players.

blocks.source: 打ち消し技は控えめに。有効時間は長めに
blocks.translation: Use Dispel Skills Sparingly and Make Their Effects Last Longer

blocks.source: ボス戦にて、凍てつく波動を始めとした補助打ち消し技の使用頻度は控えめにしておく。これにより、過度なイタチごっこを防止する。
blocks.translation: In boss battles, use support-dispelling skills such as Disruptive Wave sparingly. This prevents an excessive back-and-forth.

blocks.source: 例えば、５ターンに一回など。
blocks.translation: For example, once every five turns.

blocks.source: また、使うボスと、使わないボスを用意することでメリハリを付ける。同様に効果が持続する時間も「永続あるいはやや長め」に設定しておく。
blocks.translation: You can also create contrast by having some bosses use them and others not. Similarly, set the duration of support effects to “permanent or somewhat long-lasting.”

blocks.source: 補助技の習得者を考える
blocks.translation: Consider Who Learns the Support Skills

blocks.source: 例えば、ＤＱ９の魔法使いはバイキルト、マホカンタ、ピオリムといった補助技に加えて、守備を下げる異常技のルカニを覚える。
blocks.translation: For example, the DQIX mage learns support skills such as Bikill, Magic Barrier, and Acceleratle, as well as the debuff skill Sap, which lowers Defense.

blocks.source: 味方の物理攻撃役を支援するという意味では、バイキルトとルカニの相性は非常に良いのだが、そうなると、魔法使いが物理攻撃役の支援役になりがち。さらに、マホカンタやピオリムにまでターンを費やすと、攻撃魔法役としての華は薄くなってしまう。
blocks.translation: Bikill and Sap work very well together in terms of supporting allied physical attackers, but this tends to make the mage a support character for physical attackers. Furthermore, if the mage spends turns on Magic Barrier and Acceleratle as well, their appeal as an offensive magic user is diminished.

blocks.source: こうならないようにするには、補助技を習得するキャラを分散することが有効だ。
blocks.translation: To prevent this, it is effective to distribute the characters who learn support skills.

blocks.source: ＤＱ９の例で続けると、僧侶、旅芸人、盗賊などに分散させればよい。あるいは、詩人の様に、最初から補助に特化したイメージ通りのキャラを作ってしまうことで、魔法使いに華を戻そう。
blocks.translation: Continuing with the DQIX example, you could distribute them among the priest, minstrel, and thief. Alternatively, create a character specialized in support from the outset, such as a bard, matching the expected image and restoring the mage’s flair.

blocks.source: 対象者を自分に限定する
blocks.translation: Limit the Targets to the User

blocks.source: 対象者を自分に限定する。
blocks.translation: Limit the target to the user.

blocks.source: 何度も使う意味がなくなるので、定例作業には陥りにくい。
blocks.translation: Since there is no reason to use it repeatedly, it is less likely to become a routine task.

blocks.source: 例えば、自分の攻撃力を数ターン強化する技を作る。強化されている間に防御や回復などの行動を取ると、損をするという調整にしておき、使用するタイミングをプレイヤーに考えさせる。
blocks.translation: For example, create a skill that raises the user’s Attack Power for several turns. Adjust it so that taking defensive or healing actions while the effect is active results in a loss, encouraging players to think about when to use it.

blocks.source: 使用条件を制限する
blocks.translation: Limit the Conditions for Use

blocks.source: 補助技の使用条件に制限をかけて、定例作業化を防ぐ。
blocks.translation: Place restrictions on the conditions for using support skills to prevent them from becoming routine tasks.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＦＦ６の召喚は「１戦闘に１度しか使えない」という制限がある。
blocks.translation: For example, summons in FF6 are limited to being usable only once per battle.

blocks.source: また、ＦＦ７のリミット技（ダメージの蓄積が発動条件）のようにＭＰ消費以外の使用条件を設けるのも良い。
blocks.translation: It is also a good idea to establish conditions for use other than MP consumption, such as FF7's Limit techniques, which are activated by accumulating damage.

blocks.source: 他にも一度使用すると、一定ターン使用できないといった設定も有効だ。
blocks.translation: Another effective option is to make a skill unusable for a set number of turns after it is used.

blocks.source: ロマサガ２・３のクイックタイムのように、単純にＭＰ消費を大きくする方法もあるが、やはり、クイックタイムの様に劇的な効果が無いと使われづらいかも。
blocks.translation: You could simply increase the MP cost, as with Quick Time in Romancing SaGa 2 and 3, but unless the effect is as dramatic as Quick Time's, the skill may still go unused.

blocks.source: ザコ戦の密度を高める
blocks.translation: Increase the Density of Regular Battles

blocks.source: ザコ戦で補助技を活用させたい場合、エンカウント率を下げる代わりに、敵の強さと経験値を高めに設定すればよい。
blocks.translation: If you want players to make use of support skills in regular battles, reduce the encounter rate while setting the enemies to be stronger and award more experience.

blocks.source: これにより一戦毎に試行錯誤する必要性が出る。
blocks.translation: This creates a need to experiment and adjust your strategy in every battle.

blocks.source: また、ＤＱ３の中盤のように自由度が高い作品なら、自分より格上のザコ敵と戦う機会が多くなるので、補助技の活用機会も増えるはず。
blocks.translation: Also, in a game with a high degree of freedom, such as the middle portion of Dragon Quest III, players will have more opportunities to fight regular enemies stronger than themselves, so they should also have more opportunities to use support skills.

blocks.source: ボス戦は短期決戦を意識する
blocks.translation: Aim for Short Battles in Boss Fights

blocks.source: ボス戦が長期戦にならないようにすることで、長々と補助で強化するよりも、必要な補助だけに絞って、攻めた方が早いという状況を作る。
blocks.translation: By ensuring that boss fights do not become prolonged battles, you can create situations where it is faster to focus on only the necessary support skills and attack rather than spending a long time strengthening the party with support skills.

blocks.source: 相手によって、必要となる補助技が異なるように、うまくバランスを取りたい。
blocks.translation: I want to strike a good balance so that the support skills required vary depending on the opponent.

blocks.source: ポケモンやＦＦ、サガなどはボス戦でも短期決戦が多いのでこれが成り立つことが多い。
blocks.translation: In Pokémon, FF, and SaGa, boss fights are often short battles as well, so this approach frequently works.

blocks.source: 補助技の重要性を説明する
blocks.translation: Explain the Importance of Support Skills

blocks.source: 初心者にも、補助技の有効性を理解して欲しいならば、作中で説明を入れる事も検討しよう。チュートリアル的に教えるのも、住民に語らせるのも、方法は自由。
blocks.translation: If you want beginners to understand the effectiveness of support skills, consider explaining them within the game. You are free to teach them in a tutorial-like manner or have the townspeople explain them.

blocks.source: 「南の洞窟には、攻撃力の高い魔物が多い。ＸＸＸＸの魔法で、防御力を上げるといいぞ」というように、具体的な魔法名を挙げると、嫌でもそちらに意識が向く。
blocks.translation: For example, if someone says, “The monsters in the southern cave have high attack power. You should raise your defense with the XXXX spell,” mentioning a specific spell name will inevitably draw the player's attention to it.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 補助技については、その扱いの難しさを日頃から感じていたが、まとめてみると驚く程、既存ＲＰＧにおける補助技の問題点が浮かび上がってきた。
blocks.translation: I had long felt that support skills were difficult to handle, but when I organized my thoughts, I was surprised by how clearly the problems with support skills in existing RPGs came to light.

blocks.source: しかし、それでもなお、補助技の存在は重要で欠かせないと言える。補助技を無くして、攻撃と回復だけの戦闘にしてしまっては、余りにも戦術性に乏しいからだ。むしろ、これらの問題点は高度な戦略性を求めた結果の弊害だとも言える。
blocks.translation: Nevertheless, the existence of support skills is still important and indispensable. Removing them and making battles consist only of attacking and healing would make them far too lacking in tactical depth. Rather, these problems could be described as the negative consequences of seeking a high level of strategic depth.

lines.translation: In the [[LINK_1]]previous article (Support Skills ①: Importance and Examples)[[/LINK_1]], I introduced how support skills are implemented in commercial RPGs. This time, I will summarize the issues with support skills that emerged from that discussion and consider possible solutions.

texts.補助技の種類を厳選する: Carefully Select the Types of Support Skills
texts.有効な補助技が多数存在する場合、「戦闘開始時に長々と補助技でパーティを強化する」: When there are many effective support skills, the game is likely to fall into a routine task of “spending a long time strengthening the party with support skills at the start of battle.” Therefore, it is effective to carefully select the types of support skills you create.
texts.特に攻撃力アップ、ＣＴＢにおける素早さアップなど、常に便利すぎる補助技は意義をよ: In particular, carefully consider the purpose of support skills that are always too convenient, such as Attack Power buffs and Speed buffs in CTB.
texts.別種の補助技における重複禁止: Prevent Overlap Between Different Types of Support Skills
texts.物理半減と魔法半減など、別種の補助技の効果を重複できないようにして、同時に使用で: Prevent the effects of different support skills, such as halving physical damage and halving magical damage, from overlapping, thereby limiting which support skills can be used simultaneously. The goal is the same as carefully selecting support skills.
texts.重ねがけが有効なタイプの補助技は「ザコ戦では一度の効果が低く使いづらい」「ボス戦: Support skills designed to be effective when stacked tend to become extreme in both directions: “Their single-use effect is too weak and they are difficult to use in regular battles,” while “boss battles are easy once the party is fully buffed.” In addition, if boss battle balance is adjusted on the assumption that effects will be stacked, battles may drag on and cause the pace to suffer.
texts.基本的には重ねがけは禁止して、一度の効果を高くした方が万人受けかと思う。: As a general rule, I think it is more broadly appealing to prohibit stacking and make each use more effective.
texts.補助技にデメリットを付けることにより、使用するタイミングを考えさせる。: Adding drawbacks to support skills makes players think about when to use them.
texts.例えば「攻撃魔法を反射するが、回復魔法まで反射してしまう」「攻撃魔法を半減するが: For example: “Reflects offensive magic, but also reflects healing magic,” “Halves offensive magic damage, but also halves healing magic,” “Evades physical attacks, but makes the user more vulnerable to magical attacks,” or “Raises Attack Power but lowers Defense.”
texts.ただし、上級プレイヤー向けの感は否めないかも。: However, it may be hard to deny that this approach is geared toward advanced players.
texts.打ち消し技は控えめに。有効時間は長めに: Use Dispel Skills Sparingly and Make Their Effects Last Longer
texts.ボス戦にて、凍てつく波動を始めとした補助打ち消し技の使用頻度は控えめにしておく。: In boss battles, use support-dispelling skills such as Disruptive Wave sparingly. This prevents an excessive back-and-forth.
texts.例えば、５ターンに一回など。: For example, once every five turns.
texts.また、使うボスと、使わないボスを用意することでメリハリを付ける。同様に効果が持続: You can also create contrast by having some bosses use them and others not. Similarly, set the duration of support effects to “permanent or somewhat long-lasting.”
texts.補助技の習得者を考える: Consider Who Learns the Support Skills
texts.例えば、ＤＱ９の魔法使いはバイキルト、マホカンタ、ピオリムといった補助技に加えて: For example, the DQIX mage learns support skills such as Bikill, Magic Barrier, and Acceleratle, as well as the debuff skill Sap, which lowers Defense.
texts.味方の物理攻撃役を支援するという意味では、バイキルトとルカニの相性は非常に良いの: Bikill and Sap work very well together in terms of supporting allied physical attackers, but this tends to make the mage a support character for physical attackers. Furthermore, if the mage spends turns on Magic Barrier and Acceleratle as well, their appeal as an offensive magic user is diminished.
texts.こうならないようにするには、補助技を習得するキャラを分散することが有効だ。: To prevent this, it is effective to distribute the characters who learn support skills.
texts.ＤＱ９の例で続けると、僧侶、旅芸人、盗賊などに分散させればよい。あるいは、詩人の: Continuing with the DQIX example, you could distribute them among the priest, minstrel, and thief. Alternatively, create a character specialized in support from the outset, such as a bard, matching the expected image and restoring the mage’s flair.
texts.対象者を自分に限定する: Limit the Targets to the User
texts.対象者を自分に限定する。: Limit the target to the user.
texts.何度も使う意味がなくなるので、定例作業には陥りにくい。: Since there is no reason to use it repeatedly, it is less likely to become a routine task.
texts.例えば、自分の攻撃力を数ターン強化する技を作る。強化されている間に防御や回復など: For example, create a skill that raises the user’s Attack Power for several turns. Adjust it so that taking defensive or healing actions while the effect is active results in a loss, encouraging players to think about when to use it.
texts.補助技の使用条件に制限をかけて、定例作業化を防ぐ。: Place restrictions on the conditions for using support skills to prevent them from becoming routine tasks.
texts.例えば、ＦＦ６の召喚は「１戦闘に１度しか使えない」という制限がある。: For example, summons in FF6 are limited to being usable only once per battle.
texts.また、ＦＦ７のリミット技（ダメージの蓄積が発動条件）のようにＭＰ消費以外の使用条: It is also a good idea to establish conditions for use other than MP consumption, such as FF7's Limit techniques, which are activated by accumulating damage.
texts.他にも一度使用すると、一定ターン使用できないといった設定も有効だ。: Another effective option is to make a skill unusable for a set number of turns after it is used.
texts.ロマサガ２・３のクイックタイムのように、単純にＭＰ消費を大きくする方法もあるが、: You could simply increase the MP cost, as with Quick Time in Romancing SaGa 2 and 3, but unless the effect is as dramatic as Quick Time's, the skill may still go unused.
texts.ザコ戦の密度を高める: Increase the Density of Regular Battles
texts.ザコ戦で補助技を活用させたい場合、エンカウント率を下げる代わりに、敵の強さと経験: If you want players to make use of support skills in regular battles, reduce the encounter rate while setting the enemies to be stronger and award more experience.
texts.これにより一戦毎に試行錯誤する必要性が出る。: This creates a need to experiment and adjust your strategy in every battle.
texts.また、ＤＱ３の中盤のように自由度が高い作品なら、自分より格上のザコ敵と戦う機会が: Also, in a game with a high degree of freedom, such as the middle portion of Dragon Quest III, players will have more opportunities to fight regular enemies stronger than themselves, so they should also have more opportunities to use support skills.
texts.ボス戦は短期決戦を意識する: Aim for Short Battles in Boss Fights
texts.ボス戦が長期戦にならないようにすることで、長々と補助で強化するよりも、必要な補助: By ensuring that boss fights do not become prolonged battles, you can create situations where it is faster to focus on only the necessary support skills and attack rather than spending a long time strengthening the party with support skills.
texts.相手によって、必要となる補助技が異なるように、うまくバランスを取りたい。: I want to strike a good balance so that the support skills required vary depending on the opponent.
texts.ポケモンやＦＦ、サガなどはボス戦でも短期決戦が多いのでこれが成り立つことが多い。: In Pokémon, FF, and SaGa, boss fights are often short battles as well, so this approach frequently works.
texts.補助技の重要性を説明する: Explain the Importance of Support Skills
texts.初心者にも、補助技の有効性を理解して欲しいならば、作中で説明を入れる事も検討しよ: If you want beginners to understand the effectiveness of support skills, consider explaining them within the game. You are free to teach them in a tutorial-like manner or have the townspeople explain them.
texts.「南の洞窟には、攻撃力の高い魔物が多い。ＸＸＸＸの魔法で、防御力を上げるといいぞ: For example, if someone says, “The monsters in the southern cave have high attack power. You should raise your defense with the XXXX spell,” mentioning a specific spell name will inevitably draw the player's attention to it.
texts.補助技については、その扱いの難しさを日頃から感じていたが、まとめてみると驚く程、: I had long felt that support skills were difficult to handle, but when I organized my thoughts, I was surprised by how clearly the problems with support skills in existing RPGs came to light.
texts.しかし、それでもなお、補助技の存在は重要で欠かせないと言える。補助技を無くして、: Nevertheless, the existence of support skills is still important and indispensable. Removing them and making battles consist only of attacking and healing would make them far too lacking in tactical depth. Rather, these problems could be described as the negative consequences of seeking a high level of strategic depth.
